description: Maris Stella Labs Portfolio & Venture Studio Homepage
comment: `build` and `lint` used to be `node -e console.log(...)` and were removed rather than replaced: the build of this site is the container image .gitea/workflows/homepage-ci.yml builds, and there is no linter here to run. A gate that cannot fail is worse than an absent one, because the pipeline reports it as PASSED. `test` is the static and fake-DOM gate — see tests/. `test:e2e` is the candidate browser suite docs/QUALITY-ENGINEERING.md requires; they answer different questions and neither replaces the other.
